newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer to expand U.S. rubber output.
newsitem.headline: Bayer to expand U.S. rubber output.

text.p: Bayer AG said on Tuesday it will invest $68 million to raise annual capacity by 75,000 tonnes at a U.S. plant where it manufactures synthetic rubber.

The German pharmaceuticals and chemicals group said the expansion project at its plant in Orange, Texas, will raise output of polybutadiene and solution styrenebutadiene rubber, which are used in tyre and plastic manufacturing.
Bayer said the Texas plant investment, along with production at Bayer's Canadian plant in Sarinia, Ontario, would increase output of the synthetics rubber to almost 300,000 tonnes in North America.
Bayer also said the new production, set to be completed in 1999, would boost its annual global capacity for synthetic rubber to over one million tonnes.
